item.title: Version 1.0.0 (Build 41)
item.description:
Playground ASM model UX

  • Default model id is now amiga-playground-asm; retired names like default_model are rewritten automatically.
  • AI Settings lead with Local MLX Server and a one-click Use Playground model path so users do not need to type model ids.
  • Start MLX Server configures provider, endpoint, and product model for the bundled runtime.

item.title: Version 1.0.0 (Build 40)
item.description:
Emulator presets

  • Added ready-to-use hardware presets for A500, A500+, A600, A1200, and A4000 configurations.
  • Added FS-UAE launch presets for fullscreen, windowed HD, low-latency, classic CRT, and fast-floppy sessions.
  • Preset selections automatically apply the matching emulator settings and remain selected between launches.

item.title: Version 1.0.0 (Build 39)
item.description:
send2adf Tool Integration

  • Updated ADF floppy disk image generation to use native C-based send2adf instead of xdftool.
  • Faster, lightweight bootable floppy creation without external Python dependencies.
  • Rotated Sparkle signing key to match official release key. (This build is a one-time manual update; automatic updates resume after build 39 is installed).

item.title: Version 1.0.0 (Build 38)
item.description:
Sparkle updates

  • Added signed automatic updates and a Check for Updates command.
  • Embedded the Sparkle framework and connected the release feed.
  • Repaired the release pipeline for the bundled MLX server helper.
